decisions.reason: As the current hardware generation of a core measurement module, the voltage module carries established demand and costs little to keep in the modular catalog.
The MQTT proxy is cheap to keep available, but newer native MQTT bindings may make it redundant, so its option value is shrinking and withdrawal is a real possibility.
The CAN bus module serves a niche but lasting automation need, and holding it in the catalog is inexpensive while its demand is still uncertain.
Interest in indoor climate and ventilation monitoring has grown, which supports the value of the CO2 sensor module and justifies keeping it.
The touch panel accessory has low holding costs and fits the platform's interface offering, so it is kept despite uncertain demand and possible component supply pressure.
